title: A menu action marked '(free)' still let a hostile creature act: at Tithing's Edge with a hollow gleaner present, choosing 'get your bearings (free)' produced 'The hollow gleaner attacks at Brother Osk (-2hp...)' even though the turn counter did not advance. 'Free' is documented to cost no turn, but it was not damage-free.
